fixed: Inherited best_config per dataset: optimizer, K, batch, view batch, steps and learning rate.
scope: Five 4-image VOC21 smoke cells, then twenty fixed 128-image evaluation cells; not full-split evidence.
interpretation: All accuracy signs retained. No accuracy gate, parameter search, winner selection or promotion.

algorithm_definitions.standard: Unmodified production algorithm and original view ordering.
algorithm_definitions.staged_full: Evaluate target views first, then residual/counterfactual pairs in descending target-support order. Evaluate all candidates. Controls staging and batching.
algorithm_definitions.quality_only: Evaluate target and counterfactual views only and use min(T,C). Residual support is unobserved, not zero. No dominance attenuation.
algorithm_definitions.selective_01: Evaluate all target views, then pairs in descending measured target support. Stop when unseen target-support mass divided by that mass plus observed effective reliability is at most 0.01. Omitted weights become zero.
algorithm_definitions.selective_05: Same target-first algorithm with a fixed 0.05 omitted-weight bound. The bound controls normalized loss coefficients, not mIoU.
